title: Small-molecule annotation: from features to identity
zh_title: 小分子注释：从特征到身份
summary: Build ion, formula, and structure hypotheses, compare reference evidence, and report what remains unresolved.
zh_summary: 建立离子、分子式和结构假设，比较参考证据，并报告尚未解决的问题。

title: Lipidomics: match structural detail to evidence
zh_title: 脂质组学：让结构细节与证据相匹配
summary: Distinguish lipid class, sum composition, chains, sn positions, and double-bond evidence without overnaming a signal.
zh_summary: 区分脂质类别、总组成、链、sn 位置和双键证据，避免给信号赋予过度具体的名称。

title: Ion mobility and collision cross section
summary: Separate measured mobility coordinates from derived CCS and compare ions with explicit gas, temperature, and calibration context.
zh_summary: 区分实测淌度坐标与推导的 CCS，在明确气体、温度和校准背景下比较离子。
